document.title: [Title Excised] Possible Arrest of Two Persons Involved in Plan to Hijack U.S. Airplane in the United States
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA intelligence report on the possible arrest of two persons involved in the plan to hijack a U.S. airplane in the United States. Cited in 9/11 Commission Report Chapter 4, Endnote 113.

organizations.notes: Issuer of this information report dated 18 December 1998.

events.description: CIA information report warning that a planned operation against an aircraft in the New York area may have hit problems; two individuals may have been arrested near Washington, D.C. or New York.
Possible arrest of two individuals involved in a plan to hijack a U.S. airplane (source reported by a foreign government; details redacted).
CIA issues an information report on the possible arrest of two persons involved in a plan to hijack a U.S. airplane in the United States.
A foreign government's planned operation against an aircraft in the New York area may have hit problems.
Two individuals may have been arrested near Washington, D.C., or New York in connection with the plan to hijack a U.S. airplane.

key_claims: A foreign government reported that a planned operation against an aircraft in the New York area may have hit problems.
Two individuals involved in a plot to hijack a U.S. airplane may have been arrested near Washington, D.C. or New York.
The report was distributed on 18 December 1998 to the White House Situation Room and many U.S. agencies as unevaluated information.
